insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options mentioned: 2L; 3L/4L; 5L/7.5L/10L/15L/25L/40L/45L/65L/70L/90L/95L (Policy Schedule will specify actual SI). Deductible is mandatory as per Policy Schedule.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: 30-day waiting period (Code- Excl03): a. Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which are covered immediately. This means you can claim for accidents from day one but must wait 30 days for illness coverage.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start. You must maintain continuous coverage for 3 years before these conditions are covered.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. After 2 years of continuous coverage, these conditions become eligible for claims.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 60 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
good.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 60 days before hospitalization are covered. This helps cover diagnostic tests and treatments leading to hospital admission.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for up to 90 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge are covered. This supports recovery costs after hospital treatment.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization during the Policy Period
good.explanation: Home-based treatment is covered if medically necessary and meets criteria like minimum 3 days and inability to move. This provides flexibility for non-hospital care.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions in the form of Cumulative Bonus by increasing the Sum Insured applicable under the Policy by 5% of the Base Sum Insured of the immediately preceding Policy Year subject to a maximum of 50% of the Base Sum Insured.
good.explanation: Sum Insured increases by 5% each claim-free year up to 50%. This rewards claim-free renewals with higher coverage.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Room Rent (per day) Up to 1% of Base Sum Insured per day
bad.reference: Annexure I (Product Benefit Table) – Room Rent (per day)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped at 1% of Base Sum Insured per day, limiting room choice and possibly causing out-of-pocket expenses if a higher category is chosen.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a Hospital room where the room category opted or Room Rent incurred is higher than the eligibility as specified in the Policy Schedule, then We shall be liable to pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses... (Eligible Room Rent limit / Room Rent actually incurred) * total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: Choosing a room above the eligible category causes proportional reduction in claim payments for related expenses, increasing your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: Thereafter only the balance Sum Insured after payment of claim amounts admitted shall be available for future claims arising in that Policy Year.
bad.explanation: Sum Insured reduces after each claim with no restore or recharge, limiting coverage for multiple claims in the same policy year.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote:
ANNEXURE III  The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
List  I – Expenses not covered
... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure III (List I – Expenses not covered; also Lists II–IV)
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables like gloves and masks are excluded or subsumed, potentially increasing your out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: The following procedures / treatments shall be covered only up to the sub-limit as specified for each procedure / treatment in the below table: ... Robotic surgeries 2.5 Lac ... Stereotactic radio surgeries 3.5 Lac ...
bad.explanation: Coverage for advanced treatments like robotic surgery is capped at specified amounts, which may be insufficient for actual costs.

bad.name: Deductible
bad.quote: You have to mandatorily choose an annual aggregate claim Deductible amount, options of these Deductible amounts are provided in the section ‘Product Benefit Table’.
bad.explanation: You must pay initial claims up to the chosen deductible each year before insurer pays, increasing your out-of-pocket expenses especially for smaller claims.

bad.name: Ambulance
bad.quote: Emergency Ambulance Up to Rs.1,500 per hospitalization
bad.reference: Annexure I (Product Benefit Table) – Emergency Ambulance
bad.explanation: Ambulance coverage is limited to ₹1,500 per hospitalization, which may not cover actual ambulance costs in many locations.

bad.name: Mental Health Coverage
bad.quote: The following disorders / conditions shall be covered only up to 10% of Base Sum Insured or Rs. 50,000, whichever is lower.
bad.explanation: Certain mental health conditions have coverage capped at 10% of Sum Insured or ₹50,000, limiting financial support for treatment.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The following claim cost sharing options shall apply under the Policy if specified in the Policy Schedule and shall apply to all Insured Persons.
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-payment options that may apply depending on the Policy Schedule. Any co-pay increases your out-of-pocket costs and is considered a negative feature.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The following claim cost sharing options shall apply under the Policy if specified in the Policy Schedule and shall apply to all Insured Persons.
bad.explanation: Co-payment terms are not clearly stated in the document and depend on the Policy Schedule. Confirm from your schedule if any co-pay applies.

unclear.name: NCB Reset
unclear.quote: We will provide Loyalty Additions in the form of Cumulative Bonus by increasing the Sum Insured... by 5%... subject to a maximum of 50%...
unclear.explanation: The policy mentions cumulative bonus but does not clarify if it resets or reduces after a claim. Check your policy schedule for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
